hooks.command:
python3 -I -c 'import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
r=os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1] or os.curdir)
while not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(r,".refract/bin/agent-check")) and os.path.dirname(r)!=r:
 r=os.path.dirname(r)
pins=json.loads(sys.argv[2])
def ok(rel,digest):
 p=os.path.join(r,rel)
 return os.path.isfile(p) and not os.path.islink(p) and hashlib.sha256(open(p,"rb").read()).hexdigest()==digest
if not all(ok(k,v) for k,v in pins.items()):
 print(json.dumps({"systemMessage":"refract hook skipped: hook scripts do not match the generated hashes; re-run refract"}))
 sys.exit(0)
sys.exit(subprocess.call([sys.executable,"-I",os.path.join(r,".refract/bin/agent-check"),"--format","json"]))' "$PWD" '{".refract/bin/agent-check":"4cd9f093c25c9eead5321137ceaa273b7da1f1e1496da7e5e39b9e2641bf6975",".refract/bin/validate":"b5c393d72b373b119f2443c6da5c878824afbd1b3666b588e6d1ab4877a8b6ad"}'
